item.title: FAA Issues Nationwide Ground Stop “Due To Extraordinary Circumstances” & “Safety” Concerns
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: FAA issues rare nationwide ground stop due to equipment failure, causing travel chaos. Microsoft Outlook also down. Social media speculates about causes.
item.content:encoded:
What is going on? First, Outlook has been down for most of the day, and now the Federal Aviation Administration has issued a nationwide ground stop.

Are we good on the technology front lately? Apparently not. And like with everything else, this is somehow Donald Trump and his administration’s fault.

Anyway, according to the FAA, the unusual step of issuing a nationwide ground stop was “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety.”

In addition, the rare alert added, “all departing traffic should remain ground stopped until further notice.”

“Inbound international flights will be managed on a case by case basis,” according to the FAA.

“FAA technicians are investigating the issue,” DEI Hire Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in an online post. “We will provide immediate updates as we have them.”

Not long after the FAA’s alert, Chicago’s main airports, O’Hare International Airport and Midway International Airport, were both placed on a ground stop due to an “equipment outage,” according to NBC Chicago.

Travelers Are Already Experiencing Chaos Due To The Nationwide Ground Stoppage

NBC News shared some of the chaos travelers are experiencing:

Deveren Werne was on an American Airlines jet that was about to take off from Indianapolis to Chicago when suddenly the pilots announced that all flights were grounded.

“At first the pilot announced that there was some kind of radio issue,” Werne, 55, of Greenville, South Carolina, told NBC News in a telephone interview. “Then a little while later, the pilot said something like, ‘There is something going on that’s more serious than that.'”

Werne, a consultant who helps manufacturers and other industries adapt AI technology, said he is a frequent flyer and this was a first for him. He said there was “a mixture of emotions” from his fellow passengers on hearing the announcement.

“Then I started hearing from other friends who were on planes, including one in Chicago who was stuck on a runway,” Werne said. “Right now our plane is heading back to the terminal so at least we’re going to be able to deplane.”

At Newark Liberty International Airport, personnel in the control tower said the situation is “a whole mess right now,” according to LiveATC. “We’re running out of space” and “there’s significant gate issues” were comments also heard on the live audio feed.

“I’m as much in the dark as everyone else, I’m not getting any information from anybody,“ one controller at Newark said, according to the feed.

This Is Not The First Time A Ground Stoppage Was Issued

Nationwide ground stops are very rare, but have happened. Following the terrorist attacks on Sept. 11, the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop.

As recently as January 2023, the FAA grounded all flights due to a failure in the Notice to Air Missions system, which notifies pilots about potential dangers.

Social media has been reacting to these latest events, and as expected, they are very skeptical about what is going on following the massive Microsoft Outlook outage and recent news of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang stepping down from his role as CEO after allegedly having several extramarital affairs, one of them allegedly with a Chinese spy.

Hmmmm.

You can see more reactions below.

item.title: Biggest Takeaways From Benny The Butcher & BSF’s New Album ‘A Friend Of Ours 2’
item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: Benny The Butcher's 'A Friend Of Ours 2' showcases Black Soprano Family's gritty boom-bap sound with sharp lyricism and a meaningful message about escaping street life for wealth and growth.
item.content:encoded:
Benny The Butcher is back, and this time he’s bringing the family along for the ride.

The Buffalo rapper joins forces with Black Soprano Family and Fuego Base for A Friend Of Ours 2, a 10-track project that delivers exactly what longtime fans have come to expect from the Griselda universe.

Released November 13, the album serves as a sequel to Benny’s 2018 project of the same name. Eight years later, the Butcher has built an impressive catalog and established BSF as a formidable presence in underground Hip-Hop.

A Friend Of Ours 2 features appearances from Elcamino, Rick Hyde, Sule, Flames Dot Malik, Duckman and OT The Real. However, fans hoping for another reunion with Conway The Machine or Westside Gunn won’t find one here.

Instead, Benny and company lean into their signature sound. The production is gritty, the bars are sharp and the subject matter rarely strays far from the streets.

For fans of lyricism and what we’re calling that new-school boom-bap, there’s plenty to appreciate. If Auto-Tune and melodic rap aren’t your thing, this project might be right up your alley.

At just over 31 minutes, A Friend Of Ours 2 leaves us wanting a little more. Still, that’s hardly unusual in today’s Hip-Hop landscape.

From standout records to the album’s underlying message about growth, here are our biggest takeaways from BSF’s latest offering.

item.title: What Exactly Is Going on With ‘Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra’?
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra isn't canceled but faces serious development troubles, with scaled-back gameplay, budget overruns, and a drastically reduced scope from its original vision.
item.content:encoded:
It’s becoming a running gag regarding these Marvel video games. Unlike the movies and Disney+ series that Marvel Studios keeps pumping out, the same can’t be said for video games like Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra.

Excitement was understandably high when the Amy Hennig-led project was first announced in 2022 during the Disney and Marvel Games Showcase at D23.

Roughly two years later, during the State of Unreal keynote, we got an epic story trailer for the game, while showcasing the power of Unreal Engine 5.

But since then, it’s been crickets about the game until this week, when rumors circulated that it was canceled; however, according to someone close to the game’s development, that is not the case, but it is still suffering from development issues.

Per Kotaku:

The news of a cancelation announcement was first spread by fan account Marvel 1943 Rise Of Hydra Countdown, and was quickly picked up in fan circles. However, before it could be confirmed or elaborated upon, executive producer Lu Gigliotti posted a message in the Skydance Slack (viewed by Kotaku) stating that he had spoken “directly” with the “executive leadership team (Dan [Prigg], Shawn [Kittelson], Andrea [Benavides], etc.) [all Skydance employees]” and that the game was not canceled. “They asked me to make sure you all hear that directly. There is no truth to these claims.” Developers were told not to let the rumor distract them, and that the studio was “monitoring the situation” and would address it “through the appropriate channels.”

Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra’s Troubled Development

The game’s development has also been as close to hell as it could be. According to Kotaku’s reporting, Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra was initially pitched as a Netflix game, but was changed to a console and PC game during development.

According to the report, the game, which was supposed to drop in Holiday 2025, is playable but light on gameplay, relies on one button, and lacks significant interaction.

The game is well over budget, and the game’s length and content have been significantly scaled down from its original vision.

Kotaku reports the game is “close to done,” but does that mean we are getting the once-promising game we were salivating over after seeing the first trailer? All signs point to no.

Just a few days ago, following Skydance’s problematic $110.9 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, 30 people at Paramount Games were laid off; some of those impacted were from Skydance, but there is no indication those laid off had any significant impact on the game’s development team.

Again, we shall see.

The internet had plenty to say about the recent developments regarding Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra; you can see those reactions below.

item.title: Chrisean Rock Chin Checked Adam22 For Clowning Her Parenting Skills During ‘Wild N’ Out’
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: If we’ve learned anything about Chrisean Rock over the years that she’s been in the spotlight it’s that she’s down for whatever, whenever, however. Unfortunately for Adam22, he found this out the hard way during a taping of MTV’s Wild N’ Out. During a taping of the popular Nick Cannon show, Chrisean Rock put them […]
item.content:encoded:
If we’ve learned anything about Chrisean Rock over the years that she’s been in the spotlight it’s that she’s down for whatever, whenever, however. Unfortunately for Adam22, he found this out the hard way during a taping of MTV’s Wild N’ Out.

During a taping of the popular Nick Cannon show, Chrisean Rock put them paws on Adam22 after the podcast “porn star” made fun of her parenting skills. During a back-and-forth with Justina Valentine (who mocked Adam’s marriage with OnlyFans star, Lena The Plug), Adam fired back by clowning Valentine’s booty while throwing shade at Chrisean Rock saying “Justina, your BBL is embarrassing, but that’s nothing compared to Chrisean Rock’s parenting.”

What followed was a clearly upset Rock creeping around the crowd on stage and letting off a swing from hell that made contact with Adam’s head.

It’s worth noting that Chrisean Rock knowns how to throw them thangs and even sparred with professional boxer, Ryan Garcia, so she might’ve learned a thing or two. So much so that Adam22 actually posted a video of himself icing a swollen jaw afterwards and explaining the incident saying that he was “attacked brutally” by Chrisean Rock who “doesn’t hit like any normal girl.”

He also said the situation wasn’t funny, but it kinda was. Sorry, bro.

Naturally Adam22 said he’s considering pressing charges and that Rock even mean-mugged his pornstar wife, Lena The Plug. We feel like Chrisean Rock could take on both of them at the same time and we don’t mean in the fun OnlyFans way. Though people would pay to see that go down either way. Just sayin.’

Did Chrisean Rock take things too far or did Adam22 get what was coming to him? Check out Adam22 explain his side of the story below and let us know your thoughts about the entire situation in the comments section.

As the first rapper signed to LVRN, Kush has been making major moves with the label, delivering records that have provided a soundtrack for every season. He and YK Niece struck gold with “Friend Do,” a record […]
item.content:encoded:
After a year full of hits, Bellygang Kush is officially delivering his debut album, GOOD DOPE SELL ITSELF.

As the first rapper signed to LVRN, Kush has been making major moves with the label, delivering records that have provided a soundtrack for every season. He and YK Niece struck gold with “Friend Do,” a record that continues to get the same reaction in clubs to this day.

He followed that up with “WTF GOIN” featuring 21 Savage, giving the record an extra marketing push by teaming up with Magic City. The Atlanta strip club even gave its famous lemon pepper wings a limited-time makeover, introducing the “Belly Gang Plate.”

Earlier this week, Usher brought Bellygang an opportunity to tell his story, painting a picture of his childhood and the obstacles he’s faced with family, friendships and relationships. He’s opening up about the experiences that helped shape him into the artist he is today.

Alongside Kush, the album features a select group of artists, including Summer Walker, Wale and YFN Lucci.

With a breakout year behind him and his debut album officially here, Bellygang Kush is looking to keep that momentum going. Check out our early takeaways from GOOD DOPE SELL ITSELF below.

item.title: The Most Viral Moments From Stephen A. Smith’s Trump Interview
item.dc:creator: J. Bachelor
item.description: Stephen A. Smith is making headlines after sitting down with President Donald Trump for a wide-ranging interview at the White House. The interview was particularly significant because it came shortly after Republicans suffered major losses in the 2026 midterm elections, giving Smith an opportunity to question Trump directly about his administration’s policies and the country’s […]
item.content:encoded:
Stephen A. Smith is making headlines after sitting down with President Donald Trump for a wide-ranging interview at the White House.

The interview was particularly significant because it came shortly after Republicans suffered major losses in the 2026 midterm elections, giving Smith an opportunity to question Trump directly about his administration’s policies and the country’s political direction.

During the nearly 50-minute conversation, Smith pressed Trump about Republican losses in the midterms, his approval ratings, tariffs, immigration enforcement and the war with Iran. Trump argued that he wasn’t personally responsible for the election results, pointing instead to individual candidates and other circumstances. Smith challenged that explanation, reminding the president that he had encouraged Americans to vote as though he were on the ballot.

Another notable exchange came when Smith asked whether Trump could defeat former President Barack Obama in a hypothetical election. Trump confidently said he could and dismissed Obama’s presidential record, prompting a surprised reaction from Smith. The two also discussed the possibility of bipartisan cooperation during Trump’s remaining time in office.

Smith’s political ambitions also became part of the conversation when Trump asked whether he planned to run for office. Smith responded that he had not made a final decision, prompting Trump to warn him about the unpleasant realities of political life.

In September, Smith indicated that he would not pursue a 2028 campaign because of those professional concerns, although his latest exchange with Trump suggests he has not completely closed the door on a future political career.

Check out more clips and how the mean streets of social media felt about the exchange below.

item.title: Dame Dash Calls Monogamy “Gay” And The Internet Is Confused
item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: Dame Dash is no stranger to making bold claims. And that might be putting it lightly. The outspoken Roc-A-Fella Records co-founder is once again making headlines, this time for his controversial views on being a one-woman-man. In a resurfaced interview with Sommer Hill on the Sommer Time podcast, Dash is asked whether he believes in […]
item.content:encoded:
Dame Dash is no stranger to making bold claims. And that might be putting it lightly.

The outspoken Roc-A-Fella Records co-founder is once again making headlines, this time for his controversial views on being a one-woman-man.

In a resurfaced interview with Sommer Hill on the Sommer Time podcast, Dash is asked whether he believes in monogamy.

“Well, let me explain my perspective. I think a one-wife situation is gay,” he responds.

That answer, which he expands upon during the clip, is just one of several questionable assertions the music executive makes throughout the conversation.

During the September 30 interview, Dash also shares his thoughts on polygamy, European history and ancient Greek culture. However, his sweeping generalizations offer little historical context or supporting evidence.

“Europeans are notoriously gay,” he continues. “The Spartans were gay. The Greeks were gay. Alexander the Great was gay. Hitler was super gay.”

The remarks have since resurfaced online, sparking renewed discussion about Dash’s unconventional views on relationships.

While the original interview aired in September, clips from the conversation have recently made their way across social media. Unsurprisingly, the internet has plenty to say.

Much of the reaction pokes fun at Dash’s sweeping views on monogamy, relationships and seemingly the world in general. Others have questioned the logic behind his comments, particularly his attempt to connect historical figures and cultures to modern relationship dynamics.

Of course, Dash has built a reputation for speaking his mind, regardless of how his opinions might land. His latest viral moment only adds to a lengthy history of interviews that leave social media with plenty of material to dissect.

Whether you agree with his perspective or find the entire exchange ridiculous, there’s no denying that Dame has people talking.

So, what does the internet think about his latest take? Keep scrolling as we round up some of the funniest, sharpest and most entertaining reactions from X.

item.title: XBOX Playback Is Microsoft’s Version of Spotify Wrapped
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Beginning today, you can look back at your XBOX history and highlights across every generation with XBOX Playback, which gives gamers, for the first time, the ability to "look back and relive the part you played in XBOX's story."
item.content:encoded:
Right on time for XBOX’s 25th Anniversary, Microsoft is giving you a way to look back on your gaming history on the platform.

Beginning today, you can look back at your XBOX history and highlights across every generation with XBOX Playback, which gives gamers, for the first time, the ability to “look back and relive the part you played in XBOX’s story.”

When you sign in, you will see your total time played, most-played game, top years, longest streak, and more. You can watch your Playback directly on your console via your dashboard, or you can watch a personalized video by signing in with your XBOX account here.

Per XBOX News Wire:

XBOX Playback brings together years of XBOX history in a brand-new way. We hope Playback evokes a few memories, surprises you, or reminds you of a game you haven’t thought about in a while. Playback is based on available account data, so some parts of your history may be incomplete or take time to appear. Playback is available in 15 countries* from today through December 31.

Along with the announcement of XBOX Playback, Asha Sharma has been sharing other big news, like Firefight coming as a free update to Halo: Campaign Evolved, a bunch of free downloadable content for XBOX titles, and Slaughter Mode coming to Doom: The Dark Ages.

It sounds like XBOX has a lot planned for its 25th Anniversary, and we are looking forward to more announcements.

item.title: Lil Durk Is Still Locked Up As Judge Delays Bond Decision
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Lil Durk may have beaten the murder-for-hire charges against him, but his fight to get out of jail is far from over. The Chicago rapper appeared in a Los Angeles federal courtroom Wednesday, Nov. 4, for a bond hearing that ended without a decision. Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald said he needed more time to consider […]
item.content:encoded:
Lil Durk may have beaten the murder-for-hire charges against him, but his fight to get out of jail is far from over.

The Chicago rapper appeared in a Los Angeles federal courtroom Wednesday, Nov. 4, for a bond hearing that ended without a decision. Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald said he needed more time to consider the arguments before deciding whether Durk, whose real name is Durk Banks, can be released while awaiting his next federal trial.

Durk was acquitted in September of all five murder-for-hire charges, but still faces racketeering charges. His next trial, involving co-defendants Deandre “OTF DeDe” Wilson, David Lindsay and Asa “OTF Boogie” Houston, is scheduled to begin Aug. 30, 2027.

During Wednesday’s hearing, Fitzgerald acknowledged that “a great deal has changed” since Durk’s acquittal but said he still considers the rapper a potential danger to the community. The judge also pointed to Durk’s alleged attempt to flee before his September 2024 arrest, saying he had “indisputably attempted to flee,” although he questioned whether the move came from “guilt or panic.”

Durk’s legal team argued that keeping him incarcerated for nearly another year before trial would be excessive.

Lead attorney Drew Findling reminded the judge that high-profile figures including Jay-Z, Michael Rubin and J. Cole had submitted letters supporting Durk’s release, putting their own reputations behind the request.

Attorney Brian Steel also emphasized the length of time Durk has already spent behind bars, calling the prospect of keeping him locked up until trial “unthinkable.” Another attorney, Christy O’Connor, told the judge that Durk understood the consequences of violating any conditions of release.

Prosecutors weren’t buying it.

In a filing submitted hours before the hearing, they argued that Durk remains both a flight risk and a danger to the public, insisting his acquittal did nothing to change that assessment. They also accused him of repeatedly violating jail rules, including using other inmates’ phone access, making unauthorized three-way calls and smuggling communication devices into the facility.

Prosecutors further argued that Durk believes he is “above the law” and could use his wealth and celebrity connections to get what he wants.

His proposed bond package reportedly includes his mother’s home, cash and property from supporters, along with guarantees that the court could access his royalties, publishing income and other earnings if he fled.

Durk was acquitted in the case involving the August 2022 killing of Saviay’a “Lul Pab” Robinson in Beverly Hills. Prosecutors alleged the killing was retaliation for the 2020 death of fellow Chicago rapper King Von.

For now, Durk remains behind bars, waiting for a judge to decide whether his acquittal has changed his chances of coming home.

item.title: Kid Cudi Admits To Smoking Up To 20 Blunts A Day Before Rehab
item.dc:creator: paige.boyd
item.description: Rapper-actor Kid Cudi opens up on his "Big Bro" podcast about his past weed dependency.
item.content:encoded:
Kid Cudi is coming clean on his past extreme weed dependency.

On the latest episode of his podcast, Big Bro with Kid Cudi, the rapper-actor reveals to drummer Travis Barker that marijuana was a “constant” necessity. At one point, he estimates that he smoked between 15 and 20 blunts a day.

Around the 33-minute mark, Cudi said he had a Louis Vuitton suitcase filled with “hundreds” of pre-rolls so he could immediately light up after finishing his last one.

“If I was awake, I was smoking no matter what I was doing,” Cudi said. “I don’t want to be high… I want to like not feel this in this moment.”

The “Day ‘n’ Nite” rapper added that he was never approached about his habit because he was still functioning. “I’ve been able to be productive, but there was something for me that, I [was] just like, ‘Man, this feels wrong.'”

Cudi entered rehab during the California wildfires in early 2025, but after 3 months of sobriety, he relapsed during a “chaotic” period in his life. Among the chaos was an incident with a stalker who broke into his home following evacuations.

Cudi admits that he still smokes today, but at the behest of friends, he now approaches his relationship with weed differently.

“So like now like if I’m not doing anything, I’ll start my day with a joint, but like I’m not smoking nowhere near as many joints as I used to smoke,” he said.” I’m smoking like maybe four a day.”

Next up: Cudi is set to write, direct, and star in a film on acclaimed artist Jean-Michel Basquiat. Filming is set to start next year.

item.title: Microsoft Confirms Outlook Is Down, Social Media Says It’s Time To Clock Out For The Day
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Just before noon, Microsoft 365 announced on X (formerly social media) that Outlook was experiencing issues and that it received reports from users that they were unable to access their Exchange Online Mailboxes "through multiple connection methods in the Americas."
item.content:encoded:
There is a reason you’re not hearing the new mail notification from Outlook: Microsoft has confirmed its email client is down.

Just before noon, Microsoft 365 announced on X (formerly social media) that Outlook was experiencing issues and that it received reports from users that they were unable to access their Exchange Online Mailboxes “through multiple connection methods in the Americas.”

Microsoft 365 has revealed that it has determined what the cause of the outage was, writing on X, “We’ve determined a portion of infrastructure is experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors. We’re providing more information under EX1550543 and MO1550821 in the Microsoft 365 admin center, as well as https://status.cloud.microsoft.”

Well, there you have it.

Social media (specifically Outlook users) are happy that the email client isn’t working and are taking this as a moment to log out and close their laptops for the day.

“Take your time. The peace and quiet is nice LOL,” one person wrote in response to to Microsoft Outlook’s service outage.

Another social media user wrote, “If outlook doesn’t come back online within 30 minutes can you legally go home from work.”

We mean, no lies detected here.

As of this writing, Outlook is still down, and we are patiently waiting for it to start working again, because we are waiting for some timely emails.

Until that happens, you can see more reactions below.

item.title: Sade Will Skip Their Induction Into The Rock & Roll Hall Of Fame
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Many 80’s babies fondly remember the soothing songs and enchanting melodies of the legendary British band, Sade and now that they’re finally getting their flowers and are being inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, they’ve decided to forego the honor of being there in person to see their legacy immortalized. On Tuesday […]
item.content:encoded:
Many 80’s babies fondly remember the soothing songs and enchanting melodies of the legendary British band, Sade and now that they’re finally getting their flowers and are being inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, they’ve decided to forego the honor of being there in person to see their legacy immortalized.

On Tuesday (Nov. 10), Sade released a statement addressing the upcoming Rock & Roll Hall of Fame ceremony and said though being inducted into the R&R HOF was a “gift and a timely reminder to give thanks, not only for those who voted for us but also every single person who lets our music into their lives,” the band would not be attending the ceremony on November 14th in Los Angeles.

“Sorry we can’t be there in person to celebrate with the other artists. Please know that our absence takes nothing away from how much this recognition means to us.”

The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame has been an organization since 1983, a full year before Sade burst onto the scene with their debut album, Diamond Life in 1984. The album ultimately went diamond with more than 10 million physical copies sold, but the Rock & Roll HOF committee waited until 2026 to welcome the iconic English band into their institution. We’d might feel a ways too. Just sayin.’

We would’ve loved to see Sade Adu one more time in all her glory. So disappointing.

On the bright side, the Wu-Tang Clan are set to be inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, so at least we’ll get to see them get their flowers for not only creating some of the most memorable Hip-Hop music ever, but also propelling the Knicks to a 29-point comeback in Game 4 of the NBA Finals after their halftime performance. Yes, we’re crediting the Wu-Tang Clan for that.

Knicks in five!

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns As CEO of Nvidia Following Affair With Alleged Chinese Spy
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affairs surface, including one with alleged Chinese spy. Stock plunges $750B. National security concerns emerge.
item.content:encoded:
It never fails; a powerful man can’t keep it in his pants. Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang, is the latest example of a CEO caught cheating on his wife, but this time there are national security implications.

Following reports of Nvidia’s board of directors having discussions on how to deal with its philandering CEO after reports surfaced of Huang having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, Huang has decided to step down.

Huang co-founded the chipmaker 33 years ago and helped build it into a $4 trillion company that helped push the artificial intelligence boom.

CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO.

“The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company’s operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption,” said board chair Harvey Jones in a release.

Jensen Huang Also Had A Second Affair

Huang’s resignation also comes on the heels of reports that he had another affair with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, who joined the company in 2008 and heads the company’s healthcare business.

As expected, the news of Huang’s affair sent Nvidia’s stock tumbling; it plunged over 10% and erased -$750 billion in market cap. So you know once that happens, the board of directors, who at one point were still backing Huang, are now saying, like, whoa, our bottom line is taking a hit here.

But it’s Huang’s affair with the alleged Chinese spy that is raising major red flags due to its national security implications.

Last month, the New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence services believed the woman involved in the alleged affair, Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive, was possibly acting as an intelligence agent and reporting back to the ruling party in Beijing.

Huang, 63, did apologize on Sunday for being “unfaithful to my wife,” and also pushed back on allegations that he compromised national security or divulged Nvidia secrets during pillow talk.

Also caught up in this mess is President Donald Trump, who developed a close bond with Huang, who, along with Nvidia, has contributed to Trump’s political and civic initiatives.

Huang became one of the loudest voices on the U.S.’s AI policy and, at the same time, pushed Nvidia’s interests, specifically lobbying for chip exports to China.

This past May, Huang joined Trump on a trip to China, and while on stage at an All-In Summit to discuss AI safety and regulation, the President called in, and Huang put him on speakerphone, with Trump telling Huang and the audience, “I’m with you all the way.”

Donald Trump Claims He Didn’t Know About Huang Sleeping With An Alleged Spy

As expected, Trump claimed he didn’t know about the allegations when he invited Huang to join him on the trip to China, even though the Washington Post reports that U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio and CIA Director John Ratcliffe, briefed the administration on concerns about Alice Huang’s ties to the Chinese government.

So if Trump thinks this will go away, he better think again because when Democrats take over the government in January, you can most definitely they will look into this matter as part of their oversight duties.

It looks like both Trump and Huang could be in some serious trouble.

item.title: What We Learned From Yella Beezy’s Trial In The Mo3 Murder Case
item.dc:creator: Hip-Hop Wired Staff
item.description: News broke on Tuesday, November 11, that Dallas rapper Yella Beezy was found guilty in the murder-for-hire case involving Texas rapper Mo3. According to court proceedings, Beezy was convicted and sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole.Video from inside the courtroom shows the rapper appearing composed as the judge handed down his […]
item.content:encoded:
News broke on Tuesday, November 11, that Dallas rapper Yella Beezy was found guilty in the murder-for-hire case involving Texas rapper Mo3.

According to court proceedings, Beezy was convicted and sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole.Video from inside the courtroom shows the rapper appearing composed as the judge handed down his sentence.

Prosecutors alleged that Beezy was responsible for ordering the hit that led to Mo3’s death. Back in November 2020, Mo3 was killed in a shooting that unfolded during a high-speed chase on a Dallas highway.

The rapper’s vehicle was reportedly shot at while traveling on the highway, causing his tired to give out. A gunman then ran through traffic, approached Mo3 and fatally shot him in broad daylight.

Since his death, Mo3’s friends, family and supporters have continued to seek justice. Now, five years later, Yella Beezy has been convicted in connection with the killing.

Below, we break down the key facts from the trial and walk through what happened during Yella Beezy’s sentencing.

item.title: OutKast Retrospective Opens At Atlanta’s Trap Music Museum
item.dc:creator: paige.boyd
item.description: Step into the world of OutKast at the Trap Music Museum. Witness how they redefined southern hip-hop and music history.
item.content:encoded:
Step into the Dungeon and walk out through the stars.

Atlanta’s Trap Music Museum invites you to experience OutKast: a definitive retrospective honoring the duo whose sound redefined the South and reshaped hip-hop as we know it. Since the early 1990s, André 3000 and Big Boi have carried Atlanta’s voice onto the world stage, proving that greatness doesn’t have to come from New York or Los Angeles to matter. This exhibit traces that full arc, from their earliest days recording in Organized Noize’s legendary Dungeon studio to the global acclaim, three Grammy wins, and lasting cultural legacy that followed. Original paintings throughout the gallery bring their story to vivid life, including the cosmic “Mighty O” painting by C. Ray, a “Ms. Jackson”-inspired piece by Trinity Nixon, and a version of the Stankonia album cover made of coffee beans.

A bold cubist portrait by Jerell Gantt sets the duo against an American flag backdrop, while an immersive Afrofuturist installation, lit in violet and framed in reclaimed wood, pulls visitors into the mystical, 1970s-inspired world that shaped their visual identity. Rare memorabilia and iconic wardrobe pieces round out the experience, anchored by André 3000’s black flight jumpsuit from OutKast’s 2014 reunion tour, hand-painted with the question that still echoes today: “across cultures, darker people suffer most. why?” Come celebrate the artistry, the Atlanta roots, and the enduring voice of two of hip-hop’s most original storytellers.

item.title: SZA To Headline Coachella 2027, Nearly A Decade After Last Solo Set
item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: SZA is no stranger to performing at Coachella, but her next appearance will still feel like a full-circle moment. The seven-time Grammy Award-winning singer will join Dua Lipa and Tame Impala as headliners for the 2027 festival. Coachella returns to Indio, California, for two weekends, April 9-11 and April 16-18, 2027. SZA will close out […]
item.content:encoded:
SZA is no stranger to performing at Coachella, but her next appearance will still feel like a full-circle moment.

The seven-time Grammy Award-winning singer will join Dua Lipa and Tame Impala as headliners for the 2027 festival. Coachella returns to Indio, California, for two weekends, April 9-11 and April 16-18, 2027.

SZA will close out the festival’s third day on both weekends, marking her first time headlining the event.

The R&B superstar last appeared at Coachella in April 2026, when she joined Justin Bieber during his headlining set. The two surprised fans with a performance of their collaboration, “Snooze.”

However, SZA’s history with the festival stretches back much further. She previously performed a full set in 2018, during the early stages of her rise to superstardom. Nearly a decade later, she’ll return as one of the biggest names on the entire lineup.

SZA Leads Coachella’s R&B Lineup As Hip-Hop Takes A Back Seat

While SZA leads a strong group of R&B performers, Hip-Hop has a noticeably smaller presence among Coachella’s top-billed acts in 2027.

Don Toliver, Freddie Gibbs, Fetty Wap and several emerging rappers are among the scheduled performers. Still, no traditional rap artist holds one of the festival’s three main headlining positions.

R&B fans, meanwhile, have plenty to look forward to. Kehlani, Leon Thomas, Steve Lacy, Mariah the Scientist, Victoria Monét and Jorja Smith are among the artists scheduled to perform.

The lineup also reflects a shift from previous festivals. In 2024, Tyler, the Creator and Doja Cat occupied headlining spots, while Travis Scott received special billing in 2025.

Although Hip-Hop remains part of the festival, its biggest stars aren’t dominating the marquee this time around.

Still, SZA’s headlining appearance represents a major moment for contemporary R&B. Her journey from an emerging festival performer to a Grammy-winning headliner highlights just how far her career has come.

item.title: Yella Beezy Convicted In Mo3 Murder Case
item.dc:creator: T.E. Thomas
item.description: Yella Beezy’s murder trial has reached its conclusion, and the Dallas rapper is facing a sentence that could keep him behind bars for the rest of his life.
item.content:encoded:
The Yella Beezy and MO3 murder trial has come to a close as the jury reached its verdict on November 11, 2026. 

This week, the defense brought in private investigator and digital forensics expert Brian Ingram to break down cellphone records and location data. Ingram testified that Beezy’s phone frequently connected to cell towers near his Frisco home, gym, and a Drury Inn. He also presented GPS records showing Kewon White’s phone at Devin Brown’s home at 2:49 p.m. on the day MO3 was killed.

The defense also called Beezy’s aunt, cousin, and longtime hairstylist to the stand. His aunt testified that Beezy regularly helped support family members financially, sometimes giving relatives between $10,000 and $30,000 for bills and other expenses. She also explained that a $10,000 wire transfer was meant to help cover temporary hotel lodging while the family prepared to move.

His cousin confirmed picking up money wired to his mother, while his hairstylist testified about appointments with Beezy in Oak Cliff shortly before the murder.

Dallas rapper Yella Beezy was convicted and sentenced to life in prison in the murder-for-hire case involving rival rapper MO3. The guilty verdict was delivered on the sixth anniversary of the murder.

Yella Beezy, whose real name is Markies Conway, was accused of paying another man to gun down Dallas rapper Mo3 in an ambush on Interstate 35 in 2020. Prosecutors said Conway hired kewon white to carry out the killing over a long-running feud. Kewon has also been sentenced to life in prison without parole

Conway pled not guilty and denied his involvement; White was previously convicted of capital murder for Melvin Noble’s death. 

A third defendant, devin brown, is also charged with capital murder and is still awaiting trial.

item.title: Master P’s Son Hercy Miller Will Play His Father In Snoop Dogg Biopic
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: The casting news for the upcoming Snoop Dogg biopic keeps getting better, and the latest addition brings a little family connection to the big screen. Hercy Miller, the son of rap mogul Master P, has officially been cast to play his father in the highly anticipated film. According to Deadline, the role will mark Miller’s […]
item.content:encoded:
The casting news for the upcoming Snoop Dogg biopic keeps getting better, and the latest addition brings a little family connection to the big screen. Hercy Miller, the son of rap mogul Master P, has officially been cast to play his father in the highly anticipated film.

According to Deadline, the role will mark Miller’s feature film debut. Not exactly a bad way to get your Hollywood career started, considering he’ll be portraying one of hip-hop’s most recognizable figures in a movie about one of its biggest stars.

Miller joins a growing cast that includes P-Valley actor Zachariah Rogers, who will portray rapper and producer The D.O.C., and Tyquan Givens, who has been tapped to play an original character named B. Mack.

The film, titled Snoop, is scheduled to hit theaters on Aug. 6, 2027, with Universal Pictures behind the project. The studio has some experience bringing hip-hop stories to the big screen, having produced the 2015 N.W.A. biopic Straight Outta Compton and Eminem’s 8 Mile. So there’s reason to hope the studio can give Snoop’s story the treatment it deserves.

Other recently announced casting includes Cynthia Erivo as Afeni Shakur, the mother of the late Tupac Shakur. Jonathan Daviss, Myles Bullock, Lauren London, Camron Jones, Algee Smith, Tre Hale, Laya DeLeon Hayes, Olly Sholotan, Corey Champagne, Jonica Booth and SwayvoTwain are also among the cast members.

Craig Brewer, whose previous directing credits include Hustle & Flow and Song Sung Blue, will direct the project. Snoop himself will serve as a producer alongside Brian Grazer and Sara Ramaker for Death Row Pictures.

There’s plenty of hip-hop history to cover, from Snoop’s rise out of Long Beach to his partnership with Dr. Dre and his transformation into a global entertainment icon. The addition of Master P’s son only adds another interesting layer to a story that will inevitably feature some of rap’s most influential figures.

And Snoop hasn’t exactly been keeping a low profile lately. The rapper recently joined JAY-Z and Dr. Dre onstage at SoFi Stadium during the Los Angeles stop of the JAŸ30 celebrations.

With the August 2027 release date approaching, more casting announcements and details are likely on the way.

item.title: Cam Newton Accuses Ex of Drug Abuse, Seeks Full Custody
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: Media personality and former NFL star Cam Newton has returned to court, demanding full custody of his children and claiming his ex, Kia Proctor has “substance abuse issues” which prompted his decision. According to reports, the former Carolina Panthers quarterback filed a petition last Friday (November 6) in Fulton County Superior Court requesting full custody […]
item.content:encoded:
Media personality and former NFL star Cam Newton has returned to court, demanding full custody of his children and claiming his ex, Kia Proctor has “substance abuse issues” which prompted his decision.

According to reports, the former Carolina Panthers quarterback filed a petition last Friday (November 6) in Fulton County Superior Court requesting full custody of the four children he shares with Proctor – Chosen (born 2015), Sovereign-Dior (2017), Camidas (2018) and Cashmere (2019). Currently, Newton pays $7500 a month in support along with his joint custody rights.

In the filing, Cam Newton expresses that he has concerns about Proctor’s behavior, claiming that she has refused to bring their children to joint activities and that her issues with substance abuse has played out around the children. 

He even alleged that Proctor’s actions have led their children to be late for school, and that she has cut his access to them during her scheduled weeks of co-parenting. Newton has even alleged that Proctor isn’t interested in building relationships between the children and their half-siblings. Newton has five other children from other relationships, making nine in total including two with actress Jasmine Brown.

This is the latest episode of conflict between the two dating back to 2020, when the former ESPN commentator first filed for joint custody, paternity and parental visitation. Proctor countersued for primary custody, but the two settled in 2022. Newton would take Proctor to court again in July 2023 to regain ownership of a 2017 Bentley Bentyaga.

The two had been a couple during the bulk of his NFL career, from 2013 to 2020. Proctor has not responded publicly to the filing. Newton has been candid about their relationship, expressing his mindset in an episode of his Funky Friday YouTube series from 2022 with influencer Brittany Renner.  “I wasn’t prepared to be a husband then,” he said at the time.

item.title: Judge Dismisses Birdman From Lil Wayne Tour Bus Shooting Lawsuit
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Birdman can cross one more legal headache off his list. The Cash Money Records co-founder has been dismissed from a decade-old lawsuit filed by a former Lil Wayne tour bus driver over the infamous 2015 shooting that left two tour buses riddled with bullets outside Atlanta. Alvin Lewis, who was driving one of Lil Wayne’s […]
item.content:encoded:
Birdman can cross one more legal headache off his list. The Cash Money Records co-founder has been dismissed from a decade-old lawsuit filed by a former Lil Wayne tour bus driver over the infamous 2015 shooting that left two tour buses riddled with bullets outside Atlanta.

Alvin Lewis, who was driving one of Lil Wayne’s tour buses at the time, filed suit against Birdman and Cash Money Records, alleging assault and battery, breach of contract and intentional infliction of emotional distress. But according to TMZ, a judge ruled Tuesday that Birdman and his record label should be dismissed from the case.

The judge reportedly determined that Birdman was not in the same state when the shooting occurred and that there was insufficient evidence connecting him to the incident. The ruling also noted that Lewis was never struck by a bullet or shrapnel during the attack.

That doesn’t mean Lewis walked away unscathed, at least according to his claims. The former driver has maintained that the incident caused him emotional distress and resulted in lost income.

Birdman, however, won’t have to answer for those allegations in this particular lawsuit. And after roughly 10 years of litigation, that’s a pretty significant legal victory for the rap executive.

The lawsuit also involved rapper Young Thug and Jimmy “PeeWee Roscoe” Winfrey, who was sentenced to 10 years in prison followed by 10 years of probation for his role in the shooting.

The incident happened April 26, 2015, after Lil Wayne performed at Atlanta’s Compound nightclub. Two tour buses traveling along Interstate 285 were fired upon multiple times. Although nobody was physically injured, the shooting became a major hip-hop story because of the high-profile names involved and the questions surrounding who was responsible.

Winfrey was ultimately convicted in connection with the shooting, while Young Thug’s alleged involvement also became part of the broader legal controversy.

Lewis’ lawsuit is not entirely over, despite Tuesday’s ruling. The case can continue against the remaining defendants, but Birdman and Cash Money Records are officially out of this particular legal fight.

For the man who helped build one of hip-hop’s most recognizable record labels, it’s one less courtroom appearance to worry about.

item.title: Yo-Yo Recalls Visiting Tupac In Hospital Before His Death
item.dc:creator: J. Bachelor

RELATED: Tupac Murder Trial: Keffe D Attorney Michael Sanf Dies RELATED: Underrated Tupac Movie Roles Fans Should Revisit The […]
item.content:encoded:
Legendary rapper Yo-Yo recently sat down with Keisha Nicole of 97.9 The Box for an emotional conversation about her longtime friendship with Tupac Shakur and the ongoing pursuit of justice nearly 30 years after his murder.

The two Hip-Hop icons developed a close bond early in their careers, including time spent together while touring with Digital Underground. When asked about the latest developments involving Duane “Keefe D” Davis, who was charged in connection with Tupac’s 1996 murder, Yo-Yo reflected on what accountability could mean for his loved ones. “I just think that it gives the family a little closure,” she explained, acknowledging that there may still be more to the story. She also expressed frustration with individuals who have publicly profited from discussing the murder while Tupac’s family continues to grieve.

During the interview, Yo-Yo also revealed that she visited Tupac at a Las Vegas hospital in the days before his death. She recalled speaking to him, watching him move his head and looking into his eyes before saying a prayer over him. Despite the severity of his injuries, she remained convinced that her friend would recover. “I just knew he was coming home,” she shared.

item.dc:creator: J. Bachelor

The Grammy Award-winning singers have announced “The Boy Is Mine Vegas Residency,” their first-ever Las Vegas residency, featuring 10 performances at Resorts World Theatre beginning May 29, 2027, and concluding July 17. The news came Tuesday night (November 10) […]
item.content:encoded:
R&B legends Brandy and Monica are taking their iconic musical partnership to the Las Vegas Strip.

The Grammy Award-winning singers have announced “The Boy Is Mine Vegas Residency,” their first-ever Las Vegas residency, featuring 10 performances at Resorts World Theatre beginning May 29, 2027, and concluding July 17.

The news came Tuesday night (November 10) following their performance of their 1998 smash hit “The Boy Is Mine” during the Grammy-themed episode of “Dancing With the Stars.”

The residency follows the success of their sold-out 2025 co-headlining tour and promises a new production celebrating their individual catalogs, unforgettable collaborations and nearly three decades of R&B history.

The announcement marks another major milestone for two of R&B’s most influential voices. Their original duet, “The Boy Is Mine,” dominated the Billboard Hot 100 for 13 consecutive weeks in 1998 and earned the singers a Grammy Award for Best R&B Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocals. Their musical reunion has continued to generate excitement, from their record-breaking 2020 Verzuz battle to their successful arena tour featuring special guests Kelly Rowland, Coco Jones and Muni Long. Produced by Black Promoters Collective and AEG Presents Las Vegas, the upcoming residency will give fans another opportunity to experience the chemistry and timeless hits that made Brandy and Monica household names. Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday, November 20, at 10 a.m. Pacific through AXS, with presales beginning November 16.

item.title: Drake Says He’ll Never Perform Rihanna Collab “Take Care” Again
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: If you plan on catching Drake on his next tour, you might not be hearing one of his biggest collaborations. Drake and Rihanna have a long, complicated history, and their relationship has seemingly taken a backseat over the years. These days, Rihanna is with A$AP Rocky, who has had his own issues with the OVO […]
item.content:encoded:
If you plan on catching Drake on his next tour, you might not be hearing one of his biggest collaborations.

Drake and Rihanna have a long, complicated history, and their relationship has seemingly taken a backseat over the years. These days, Rihanna is with A$AP Rocky, who has had his own issues with the OVO rapper.

The two MCs have exchanged shots back and forth, most notably during the Kendrick Lamar and Drake beef. On “Family Matters,” Drizzy took a shot at Rocky, suggesting he stay out the situation.

“Rakim talking sh*t again, gassed cause you hit my BM first, n*gga, do the math who I was hittin’ then?”

Rocky’s boo, Rihanna has timeless records with his op, Drake. Whenever that next tour will be, fans may not be hearing the song “Take Care” anymore.

During a recent livestream, Drake played their 2011 collaboration “Take Care” and suggested it could be his final time performing the record.

“This the only performance you’re getting of this song probably, but sh*t, welcome to Trainwreckstv, baby.”

This isn’t the first time Drake has hinted at retiring one of his Rihanna collabs. Back in 2024, while performing in Tampa, Florida, he asked the crowd to sing “Work” for him instead of performing it.

“I don’t sing this song anymore. You can sing it for me.”

With Drake seemingly ready to leave these collaborations in the past, fans may have to appreciate the classic through their playlists rather than at his next show.

item.title: It’s Pre-Load Day: Rockstar Games Share ‘GTA 6’ PS5 Pro Features, Will Target 30 FPS & More
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: GTA 6 launches in 9 days with 9.69M preorders and $942M in revenue. PS5 Pro offers superior graphics, while Xbox gets cloud gaming access. All consoles run at 30 FPS.
item.content:encoded:
Holy sh*t, Grand Theft Auto 6’s launch is just nine days away, and today is pre-load day, and Rockstar Games has shared a ton of information about the game.

Gamers around the world woke up to their PS5 and Xbox consoles telling them GTA 6 is ready to pre-load.

Along with that, Rockstar Games shared a boatload of information and basically confirmed that PS5 Pro is still the best place to play GTA 6.

Here’s Why PS5 Pro Is The Best Place To Play GTA 6 According To Rockstar Games

While the game looks graphically stunning on the base PS5 model, the PS5 Pro will take things to another level thanks to PSSR support, which uses Sony’s upscaler to deliver cleaner images than the base PS5 model.

The PS5 Pro version of the game will also exclusively boast ray-traced shadows, which those with sharp eyes and a knack for graphical enhancements will notice during their adventures in Leonida, depending on the time of day.

PS5 players can also look forward to gameplay features that take full advantage of the DualSense Controller’s exceptional haptic controls, delivering a one-of-a-kind experience.

Don’t Worry XBOX Owners, You Have Not Been Forgotten

XBOX Series S | X owners, don’t worry, you have not been forgotten. Even though PlayStation does have an exclusive marketing agreement with Rockstar Games for GTA 6, there are still some cool things to look forward to when the game launches on Microsoft’s consoles.

Rockstar Games announced GTA 6 will be available via Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch, meaning you don’t need an XBOX console to play the game. You can even play the game on the Xbox One via cloud streaming, which is a technical achievement in itself if it runs smoothly.

Keep in mind, the game running without hiccups also depends on your internet connection.

Asha Sharma Confirms XBOX’s Deal With Rockstar Games

XBOX CEO Asha Sharma confirmed this news, saying it “marks the first step” in XBOX’s “10-year strategic partnership with Take-Two,” and also revealed GTA 6 is the “most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store,” a claim PlayStation has also made for its digital storefront.

Now, PS5 owners cannot stream the game, but you can enjoy it via remote play, so you can put that PS Portal to use. You can also play the game via remote play on Xbox consoles.

No Surprise, GTA 6 Is Confirmed To Run At 30 FPS On Consoles

It should come as no surprise that GTA 6 will run at 30 FPS on consoles, which is to be expected for a game pushing the graphical fidelity we have seen in the numerous trailers.

Also, Red Dead Redemption II, which came out in 2018, is still locked at 30 FPS, so again, it’s no surprise that GTA 6 is also locked at the same framerate.

The console wars are all but dead, but if you spend a lot of time on social media, gaming discourse has become so toxic that GTA 6 running at 30 FPS on both consoles has sparked all kinds of reactions.

Mainly, those who plant their flags for XBOX are using this moment to claim it as a victory because the PS5 Pro, which is being touted as the best console to experience the game, is running the game at 30 FPS, like on the XBOX One, despite there being clear graphical improvements on the PS5 Pro.

Also, keep in mind that it’s only streaming, and Xbox just put a significant cap on how much time you can stream on the cloud each month.

GTA 6 Is Already Bringing In A Lot of Money

Regardless, despite a “boycott” that didn’t produce any results, Polygon reports that GTA 6, as expected, is the sales juggernaut it was expected to be.

Per Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has surpassed 9.69M preorders and has already brought in an eye-watering $942 million in revenue.

GTA 6 is well on its way to smashing the record set by its predecessor, GTA V, which holds the distinction of being the most profitable piece of modern entertainment and has made more money than any book or film.

Regardless, amongst the excitement, there is a whole lot of yapping about this game running at 30 FPS and more.

You can see those reactions below.
